title: WEKA-BASED DECISION-TREE MODEL FOR USER SUBSCRIPTION PLAN PREDICTION
venue: Technological University of the Philippines - Manila (IT323 Business Intelligence course project)
tldr: A WEKA-based decision-tree model using the J48 algorithm to predict streaming subscription plans based on demographic and behavioral attributes, achieving 72% accuracy with country identified as the most influential predictor.
problem_and_motivation: Understanding user preferences in subscription plan selection is vital for implementing data-driven strategies in competitive streaming landscapes. There is a gap in analyzing how individual user attributes affect subscription plan selection.
approach: Supervised classification model using J48 decision-tree algorithm in WEKA with an 80/20 train-test split on 2,500 anonymized user records. Performance evaluated using accuracy, Kappa statistic, precision, recall, F-measure, and ROC area.
findings: num: The model achieved 72% overall accuracy with country identified as the most influential predictor
num: Country was followed by age and device type as the next most important predictors
num: Standard category achieved the highest precision (0.793) and ROC area (0.871)

Table 3: Predictive Performance of Decision Tree Model

limitations: The study is limited to a single streaming platform with only 2,500 anonymized records. The dataset excludes behavioral indicators such as watch time, session frequency, or genre preferences that could further improve prediction accuracy.
remember_this: Decision tree models can effectively predict subscription plans based on demographic attributes, with country being the most influential predictor. The model achieved 72% accuracy, meeting the 70% benchmark for commercial applications.
